@about: Nesting add-on (0.8 NEST-CAD-PATH). Words of the add-on only.
cmd.nest.help: Lay the selected closed outlines (polylines, circles, with their holes) on plates or a roll and draw the sheets beside the drawing.
ask.select: Select the closed outlines to nest
err.none: Nothing to nest: select closed polylines or circles.
note.skipped: {n} objects left out: only closed polylines and circles are nested (close an open polyline first).
ask.margin: Margin kept clear at the edges
ask.turn: Turn the parts [90 degrees/Any angle/No turning]
done.plates: Nested {n} parts. Plates used: {sheets}, {eff} % of their area.
done.roll: Nested {n} parts on {len} of roll, {eff} % of the roll used.
warn.too_big: {name} is bigger than the sheet: not placed.
warn.no_room: {name} did not fit on the plates available.
note.checked: Checked again on the exact shapes: no part overlaps another or comes closer than the spacing, all inside the margins.
